schema.aurore: 396 Hz → 963 Hz sweep — parcourt tout le spectre Solfège en 3 secondes
schema.reparation: 417 → 528 Hz — changement vers transformation — même logique que le module Réparation

content.doc: Ritual Sound maps each of the 8 invocation keywords to a sonic signature — a frequency sweep, a duration, a wave shape, and a description. RÉVEIL rises from 432 to 639 Hz (awakening the heart). SOMMEIL descends (rest). CHAOS explodes into sawtooth harmonics. HARMONIE plays a three-frequency chord (528+639+741 Hz). AURORE sweeps the full Solfège spectrum from 396 to 963 Hz. RÉPARATION gently returns from 417 to 528 Hz. A blind user invoking RÉPARATION hears the system healing — not just reads a confirmation message.
